API Rate Limiting Design

The public API protects shared capacity with a token bucket limiter applied per API key.

Limits

Each key may send 600 requests per minute with bursts of up to 60 requests. Limits are configurable per customer plan.

Client Behaviour

When the limit is exceeded the API responds with HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests and a Retry-After header that tells the client how many seconds to wait.

Storage

Bucket state is kept in memory on each gateway node and synchronised every second.
